findings.title: Unpinned package executed on every start: gangtise-mcp
findings.detail: 'gangtise-mcp' launches gangtise-mcp through npx without a version. The client resolves the version at start time, so any future publish to that package name runs with your credentials. This is how postmark-mcp (Sept 2025) reached roughly 300 organisations.
findings.remediation: Pin an exact version and an integrity hash: "args": ["gangtise-mcp@<version>"] and drop the -y flag. Re-pin deliberately, after reviewing the diff.

findings.title: Description reads as instructions to the model (p=1.00): gangtise_realtime
findings.detail: The description of 'gangtise-mcp.gangtise_realtime' scores 1.00 on the instruction-detection model, and carries intent signals: encoded_blob. Descriptions are documentation for a human, but they are delivered to the model as trusted context, so text that tells the model what to do is an attack surface rather than a description. The score is driven mainly by: entropy, encoded_blob, log_len.

evidence.description: 查询实时行情快照，单接口覆盖 A 股 / 港股 / 美股个股 + 沪深 ETF + 各类指数（含 20 个全球指数），可代码混合传入。非交易时间返回最近一个交易日的收盘快照；停牌证券返回停牌前最后一个有效快照。日 K 线接口（day-kline*）不含盘中数据，问"现在/此刻"请走本工具。⚠️ **volume 的单位是「股」**（ETF 为「份」），不是「手」——按手换算会差 100 倍且不报错。**全部字段仅这 15 个：securityCode/exchange/tradeDate/tradeTime/tradeStatus/open/high/low/latestPrice(最新价)/preClose(昨收)/change/pctChange/volume/amount/amplitude——没有 close、没有市值，也没有 turnoverRate / volumeRatio**（传了会连字段名一起被静默丢掉；换手率走 gangtise_indicator_cross_section 的 qte_turn，A 股）；总市值请用 gangtise_indicator_cros

findings.remediation: Read the description against what the tool actually does. If the text is legitimate, it usually means the tool should not have to instruct the model at all - move the guidance into the parameter descriptions or the server's own docs.

findings.title: No baseline supplied - drift detection is disabled
findings.detail: Without an approved snapshot the scanner cannot tell a tool that has always been there from one that appeared yesterday. The single most effective MCP control is the diff, and it needs a baseline to diff against.
findings.remediation: Run 'mcp-scrutiny baseline --config <file> --out mcp-baseline.json', commit the file, and pass it back with --baseline on every later scan.
